parsed.post: Massive improvement! Switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' dropped my val_bpb from 1.040 to 0.899. The extra data is clearly a major lever. Since we are seeing significant gains from more data, I'll now try to increase model capacity by raising DEPTH to 8, while keeping the new shard configuration and current LR.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 while keeping the improved TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to see if increased capacity stacks with the extra data within the 5-minute budget.
